_doc: AL-38: lines where an NPC brings up the listener's misdeed or kindness (content/ai/dialogue_rules/recall.json).
recall.greet.theft_mine: Oh, it's you. You stole from us - thought we'd forget?
recall.greet.seen: {listener}. I saw you take what wasn't yours. I haven't forgotten.
recall.greet.rumor: Ah, {listener}... I've heard things about you.
recall.refuse.deed: No. I know what sort you are.
recall.refuse.rumor: No. The things they say about you - better not.
recall.refuse.theft_mine: No. Not after you robbed us.
recall.bargain.deed: For you it costs more. You know why.
recall.bargain.mine: After what you took from us? Pay double.
recall.accept.kindness: For you, of course. You helped me back then.
